Pro sits // on a faint tint instead of a loud ring, to keep the section calm. import { ArrowRight, RefreshCw } from "lucide-react" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" const PLANS = [ { name: "Free", price: "$0", per: "forever", body: "For getting started and for the odd side project.", lead: "What you get", points: [ "Up to three clients, with as many invoices as you like.", "Clients pay by card or bank transfer from the invoice.", "One polite reminder when an invoice is late.", "A small Orbit line at the bottom of each invoice.", ], cta: "Start free", href: "#start", }, { name: "Pro", price: "$12", per: "a month", body: "For when invoicing is how you pay the rent.", lead: "Everything in Free, and", points: [ "No limit on clients, so there is room to grow.", "Reminders before and after due dates, in your voice.", "Your logo and colors on invoices, and none of ours.", "Recurring invoices, late fees and a forecast.", ], cta: "Try Pro free for 14 days", href: "#trial", pro: true, }, ] export default function PricingTwoPlans() { return (
